notes: Fixed: the island stayed open instead of going back to its resting pill
The auto-collapse countdown was being reset by every refresh — a download's progress or a track's playhead kept pushing it back, so it never fired
A live activity no longer pins the island at the compact size forever; it settles back to the pill once nothing new has happened
Gestures → Going back to rest sets how long that takes, or restores the always-compact behaviour
Added a guard that re-asserts the size if an interrupted animation leaves the island stuck
